title: Preview unpack reports a type error after allocation fails
root_cause: The process limits its address space to 96 MiB, then requests a 128 MiB buffer. Allocation raises MemoryError, and the fallback passes None to unpack_from, producing the later TypeError.

relevant_evidence.why: A MemoryError precedes the later TypeError.
The process limit is smaller than the allocation and the fallback passes None onward.
